# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_data_dictionary.py from
     information_schema and docs/data_dictionary.json. Edit the
     JSON, not this file. -->

Every table and view in the `steam_pipeline` database, by layer: raw landing, normalized tables, analytics marts, views, operations, and legacy. All timestamps are UTC. Structure is read from `information_schema`; descriptions live in `docs/data_dictionary.json`. Sources and their caveats are in [`sources.md`](sources.md), how marts are built in [`marts.md`](marts.md), which tables feed which mart in [`lineage.md`](lineage.md), and the data-quality checks in [`observability.md`](observability.md).

## Raw landing layer

Every API response, stored before parsing so any run can be reprocessed.

### `raw_api_responses` (table)

One row per API request any job made, including failed ones. Bodies are zlib-compressed; a body identical to the previous one for the same request is stored once, and later rows point to it. Bodies older than `RAW_RETENTION_DAYS` are removed; metadata is kept.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `response_id` | bigint unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | yes | index | The job run that made the request. |
| `source` | varchar(50) | no | index | Logical source, e.g. `valve_top_concurrent` (see sources.md). |
| `endpoint` | varchar(255) | no |  | Request URL without parameters. |
| `request_params` | json | no |  | Request parameters as JSON. |
| `request_params_hash` | char(64) | no |  | SHA-256 of endpoint plus canonical parameters; identifies the same request across runs. |
| `http_status` | smallint unsigned | yes |  | HTTP status; NULL when the request failed before a response (see error_message). |
| `fetched_at` | datetime(6) | no | index | When the response was received (collection time, not source time). |
| `payload` | mediumblob | yes |  | zlib-compressed response body; NULL for duplicates, failures and purged bodies. |
| `payload_sha256` | char(64) | yes |  | SHA-256 of the uncompressed body; kept after purging. |
| `payload_bytes` | int unsigned | yes |  | Uncompressed body size. |
| `is_duplicate_of` | bigint unsigned | yes | index | The earlier row holding an identical body for the same request. |
| `payload_purged_at` | datetime(6) | yes |  | When retention removed the body. |
| `error_message` | text | yes |  | Connection error text for requests without a response. |

## Catalog and dimensions

Loaded by `catalog_daily` from the SteamSpy catalog page and the Steam Store.

### `games` (table)

One row per app ID seen in the SteamSpy catalog or tracked. Name and companies come from the newest catalog run.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `name` | varchar(255) | no |  |  |
| `developer` | varchar(500) | yes |  | Raw SteamSpy developer string; normalized links are in game_developers. |
| `publisher` | varchar(500) | yes |  | Raw SteamSpy publisher string; normalized links are in game_publishers. |
| `languages` | text | yes |  | Raw SteamSpy languages; empty for catalog-page games (use game_languages). |
| `genre` | varchar(500) | yes |  | Raw SteamSpy genre; empty for catalog-page games (use game_genres). |
| `first_seen_at` | datetime(6) | no |  | Load time of the first catalog run that included the game. |
| `last_seen_at` | datetime(6) | no |  | Load time of the latest catalog run that included the game. |

### `game_metric_snapshots` (table)

SteamSpy values per game per catalog run, append-only. SteamSpy gives no source time and can stay unchanged for long periods; use for broad comparison, not as a time series.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `snapshot_time` | datetime(6) | no | index | Collection time of the catalog run (not when SteamSpy measured the values). |
| `owners` | varchar(100) | yes |  | SteamSpy owner range as text, e.g. `10,000,000 .. 20,000,000`. |
| `owners_low` | bigint unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `owners_high` | bigint unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `estimated_owners` | bigint unsigned | yes |  | Midpoint of the owner range. |
| `positive_reviews` | int unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `negative_reviews` | int unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `total_reviews` | int unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `review_score_percent` | decimal(5,2) | yes |  | SteamSpy positive share (positive / total reviews). |
| `average_playtime_forever_minutes` | int unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `average_playtime_2weeks_minutes` | int unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `median_playtime_forever_minutes` | int unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `median_playtime_2weeks_minutes` | int unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `ccu` | int unsigned | yes |  | SteamSpy's concurrent-user figure; not a reliable current-player count. |
| `price_cents` | int unsigned | yes |  | SteamSpy price in US cents. |
| `initial_price_cents` | int unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `discount_percent` | tinyint unsigned | yes |  |  |

| `name` | varchar(255) | no | unique |  |

| `app_type` | varchar(30) | yes |  |  |

| `release_date_text` | varchar(100) | yes |  | The Store's release date text as returned (English). |

| `is_free` | tinyint(1) | yes |  |  |

| `platform_linux` | tinyint(1) | yes |  |  |
| `recommendations_total` | int unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `details_fetched_at` | datetime(6) | no | index | Load time of the run that last refreshed the Store details. |
| `tags_fetched_at` | datetime(6) | yes |  | Load time of the run that last refreshed the SteamSpy tags. |

### `game_price_history` (table)

Type 2 price history per game and Store country: a new version opens when the daily price check sees a change; unchanged prices write nothing.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `price_id` | bigint unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | index |  |
| `country_code` | char(2) | no |  |  |
| `price_state` | varchar(12) | no |  | `priced`, `no_price` (sold without a price, e.g. free to play) or `unavailable` (Store returned no data). |
| `currency` | char(3) | yes |  | ISO currency of the amounts; amounts are never compared across currencies. |
| `initial_price` | int unsigned | yes |  | Price before discount, in minor units (cents). |
| `final_price` | int unsigned | yes |  | Price paid, in minor units (cents). |
| `discount_percent` | tinyint unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `valid_from` | datetime(6) | no |  | Load time of the check that first saw this price. |
| `valid_to` | datetime(6) | yes |  | Load time of the check that saw it change; NULL while current. |
| `is_current` | tinyint(1) | no |  | TRUE for the open version; at most one per game and country. |
| `opened_by_run_id` | bigint unsigned | no | index |  |
| `closed_by_run_id` | bigint unsigned | yes | index |  |
| `current_key` | varchar(20) | yes | unique, generated | Generated: makes the open version unique per game and country. |

## Observations, history and events

Loaded by `players_hourly` and `reviews_daily`.

### `player_observations` (table)

One row per game per hourly players run (top-100 chart or direct lookup). Rows older than `PLAYER_HOURLY_RETENTION_DAYS` are deleted; player_daily keeps their rollups.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `observation_id` | bigint unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | no | index |  |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | index |  |
| `collected_at` | datetime(6) | no | index | Load time of the run (collection time). |
| `source_measured_at` | datetime(6) | yes |  | Valve's measurement time from the top-100 chart; NULL for direct lookups. |
| `current_players` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `player_rank` | smallint unsigned | yes |  | Rank in Valve's top-100 concurrent-player chart; NULL for direct lookups. |
| `source` | varchar(10) | no |  | `top100` (chart) or `direct` (GetNumberOfCurrentPlayers). |

### `player_daily` (table)

Daily rollup of player_observations per game and UTC day, recomputed for the days each players run touches. Kept forever.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `observation_date` | date | no | PK | UTC date of the measurement time (source time when known, otherwise collection time). |
| `peak_players` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `avg_players` | decimal(12,2) | no |  |  |
| `min_players` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `observation_count` | smallint unsigned | no |  |  |
| `best_rank` | smallint unsigned | yes |  | Best top-100 rank that day; NULL when only direct lookups. |
| `updated_at` | datetime(6) | no |  | Load time of the run that last recomputed the row. |

### `most_played_daily` (table)

Valve's daily-peak leaderboard (top 100 by peak players). Not limited to catalog games, so appid has no foreign key.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rollup_date` | date | no | PK | The UTC day the peaks refer to (the previous complete day at fetch time). |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `player_rank` | smallint unsigned | no |  |  |
| `last_week_rank` | smallint unsigned | yes |  | Rank a week earlier; NULL when Valve reports the game was not ranked (-1). |
| `peak_players` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | no | index | The players run that last wrote the row. |

### `review_observations` (table)

Steam review summary per tracked game per reviews run (all languages and purchase types).

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `observation_id` | bigint unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | no | index |  |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | index |  |
| `collected_at` | datetime(6) | no |  | Load time of the run (the summary has no source time). |
| `positive_reviews` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `negative_reviews` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `total_reviews` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `review_score_percent` | decimal(5,2) | yes |  |  |
| `review_score` | tinyint unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `review_score_desc` | varchar(50) | yes |  | Steam's rating label, e.g. `Very Positive`. |

### `review_rollups` (table)

Up and down review counts per period from Steam's review histogram, with the source's own dates: monthly for each game's life, daily for the last 30 days.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `rollup_type` | varchar(5) | no | PK | `month` or `day` (the histogram returned no weekly buckets). |
| `period_start` | date | no | PK | First day of the period (UTC), as given by the source. |
| `recommendations_up` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `recommendations_down` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `is_partial` | tinyint(1) | no |  | The period contains the fetch date and was still filling. |
| `fetched_at` | datetime(6) | no |  | Load time of the newest fetch; an older fetch never overwrites it. |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | no | index |  |

### `review_reconciliation` (table)

Per reviews run and game: the histogram's monthly totals compared with the review summary. Counts are recorded; only the positive share is held to a tolerance.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reconciliation_id` | bigint unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | no | index |  |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | index |  |
| `checked_at` | datetime(6) | no |  |  |
| `histogram_total` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `summary_total` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `count_difference_percent` | decimal(8,2) | yes |  | (histogram total - summary total) / summary total. |
| `histogram_positive_share` | decimal(5,2) | yes |  |  |
| `summary_positive_share` | decimal(5,2) | yes |  |  |
| `share_difference_points` | decimal(5,2) | yes |  | Absolute difference of the positive shares, in percentage points. |
| `tolerance_points` | decimal(5,2) | no |  |  |
| `within_tolerance` | tinyint(1) | no |  | share_difference_points <= tolerance_points. |

### `game_events` (table)

Steam news and update posts per game, one row per news gid; article text is not stored.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gid` | varchar(32) | no | PK |  |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | index |  |
| `title` | varchar(500) | no |  |  |
| `url` | varchar(1000) | yes |  |  |
| `event_time` | datetime | no |  | Publication time from the source (UTC). |
| `feed_label` | varchar(100) | yes |  |  |
| `feed_name` | varchar(100) | yes |  |  |
| `feed_type` | tinyint unsigned | yes |  | 1 = the developer's Steam announcements, 0 = external press. |
| `is_patch_notes` | tinyint(1) | no |  | The item carries Steam's `patchnotes` tag. |
| `is_developer_post` | tinyint(1) | no |  | feed_type = 1. |
| `first_seen_at` | datetime(6) | no |  | Load time of the run that first stored the item. |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | no | index |  |

## Analytics marts

Rebuilt after every job by `db/transforms/` (see marts.md and lineage.md).

### `mart_player_trends` (table)

Per game and UTC day: peak and average players, 7-day rolling average, day- and week-over-week peak change, rank and its change, top-100 membership, entries and exits, 7-day volatility.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `observation_date` | date | no | PK |  |
| `name` | varchar(255) | no |  |  |
| `peak_players` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `avg_players` | decimal(12,2) | no |  |  |
| `avg_players_7d` | decimal(12,2) | no |  |  |
| `peak_change_pct_dod` | decimal(16,2) | yes |  |  |
| `peak_change_pct_wow` | decimal(16,2) | yes |  |  |
| `best_rank` | smallint unsigned | yes |  |  |
| `rank_change_dod` | smallint | yes |  | Yesterday's best rank minus today's; positive means the game moved up. |
| `in_top100` | tinyint(1) | no |  |  |
| `days_in_top100` | int unsigned | no |  |  |
| `entered_top100` | tinyint(1) | no |  |  |
| `exited_top100` | tinyint(1) | no |  |  |
| `volatility_7d_pct` | decimal(12,2) | yes |  | Coefficient of variation of the daily average over 7 days, in percent. |

### `mart_player_peak_hours` (table)

Per game: the most frequent hour (Prague time) of the daily player peak, over days with at least 12 hourly observations.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `appid` | int unsigned | no | PK |  |

## Operations

Run audit, data quality and schema history.

### `pipeline_runs` (table)

One row per job run, with status, counters and messages.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `job_name` | varchar(50) | no | index | `catalog_daily`, `players_hourly`, `reviews_daily`, `backfill`, or `daily_legacy` for runs before the job split. |
| `started_at` | datetime(6) | no |  |  |
| `finished_at` | datetime(6) | yes |  |  |
| `status` | varchar(20) | no | index |  |
| `rows_extracted` | int unsigned | no |  | Rows received from the job's main source. |
| `rows_loaded` | int unsigned | no |  | Rows loaded (games, observations or rollups, depending on the job). |
| `measurements_loaded` | int unsigned | no |  | Player or review observations loaded. |
| `rows_rejected` | int unsigned | no |  | SteamSpy rows rejected by row-level validation (catalog runs). |
| `error_message` | text | yes |  | Why a FAILED run failed. |
| `warning_message` | text | yes |  | Degraded input and failed checks of a successful run, one per line. |

### `data_quality_results` (table)

Every data-quality check and mart test result, stored after every run (see observability.md).

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `result_id` | bigint unsigned | no | PK |  |
| `check_name` | varchar(60) | no | index |  |
| `target` | varchar(150) | no |  | The source, table or table.column checked. |
| `run_id` | bigint unsigned | yes | index |  |
| `status` | varchar(4) | no | index | `pass`, `warn` or `fail`; a fail adds a run warning and never deletes data. |
| `observed_value` | varchar(100) | yes |  |  |
| `threshold` | varchar(150) | yes |  |  |
| `details` | text | yes |  |  |
| `checked_at` | datetime(6) | no |  | When the check ran. |

### `flyway_schema_history` (table)

Flyway's record of applied migrations.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `installed_rank` | int | no | PK |  |
| `version` | varchar(50) | yes |  |  |
| `description` | varchar(200) | no |  |  |
| `type` | varchar(20) | no |  |  |
| `script` | varchar(1000) | no |  |  |
| `checksum` | int | yes |  |  |
| `installed_by` | varchar(100) | no |  |  |
| `installed_on` | timestamp | no | generated |  |
| `execution_time` | int | no |  |  |
| `success` | tinyint(1) | no | index |  |
